name: nominal
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0
ahdl_include "dut.va"
simulator lang=spice
.include "models.spice"
.include "ldo_ota5.spi"
.temp 27
VIN vin 0 PWL(0 0 1u 0 2.1e-05 1.8 7.1e-05 1.8)
VREF vref 0 0.8
IBIAS vin ibias 50u
RLOAD vout 0 120
XLDO vin vout 0 vref ibias fb gate_drive gate ldo_ota5
RFBTOP vout fb 300k
RFBBOT fb 0 600k
VLOOP gate_drive gate 0
RESR vout vcap 50m
COUT vcap 0 1e-06
simulator lang=spectre
VOBSIN (vin vin_read) vsource dc=0
VOBSOUT (vout vout_read) vsource dc=0
XM (vin_read vout_read t90_us overshoot_mv settle_us reached settled status done) ldo_startup_meter ramp_end=2.1e-05 window=7e-05
tran tran stop=7.1e-05 maxstep=5n errpreset=conservative
save VOBSIN:p VOBSOUT:p vin vout t90_us overshoot_mv settle_us reached settled status done
